brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey

finish.summary:
I built a three-storey tower from three north-half hex bases stacked in one cell (levels 0, 1 and 2), joined with two snaps. There's a drawer on the bottom storey and an open two-compartment bin on the top storey. I ran the house rules: they added 7 solid end caps, and the joint lock had nothing to add. The final check passed with no issues and meshes clear.

I used half bases because drawers only fit on the cut face of a half base, and a half base can only carry the same kind above it. So the whole tower is half-width. The middle storey is just structure, and the cut faces on the upper storeys don't have drawers.

I placed the first parts with direct changes and only used plan_build for the drawer, so the build doesn't strictly follow the plan-first workflow. I left out props because the brief is about structure, not use.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
